description: Define which solver results show per component (Node / Segment / Space / Graph). Wire a solver's output into this node — row keys match the solver's result keys; label/unit/step style the Metrics rows.
instructions:
A terminal (input only) — defines which RESULT rows a solver publishes into each component's Metrics tab, via the same four foldable sections as Input Schema (Node / Segment / Space / Graph).

Wire a solver's output (e.g. Pipe Network Solver) into it: each row's key must MATCH a result the solver writes (e.g. node head / pressure; segment discharge / velocity / headloss / unitHeadloss); label/unit set the display, step sets the decimals.

NOTE: the four sections are edited by the on-node schema editor; `name` is an optional label.
